Filter a domain to the visits of interest

FilterVisits.Rd

Applied before any CTAS timeseries is constructed. Both patterns are deliberately parameterised: sponsors encode scheduled visits differently, so the defaults must stay permissive and any sponsor-specific convention must be supplied through the workflow YAML rather than baked into the mapping layer.

Usage

FilterVisits(
  dfInput,
  strVisitCol = "VISIT",
  strVisitPattern = NULL,
  strExcludePattern = "unsch"
)

Arguments

dfInput

data.frame Containing the visit column.

strVisitCol

character Name of the visit column.

strVisitPattern

character Regular expression that a visit must match to be retained. NULL (default) keeps all visits.

strExcludePattern

character Regular expression whose matches are dropped. Matched case-insensitively. Default "unsch" removes unscheduled visits. NULL disables the exclusion.

Value

data.frame A filtered copy of dfInput.
